name: vault-game-collection
description: Gestor retro de coleções de videojogos para web e Android

scripts.build: mkdir -p www/assets www/downloads && cp index.html styles.css retro.css landing.css app.js config.js manifest.webmanifest service-worker.js robots.txt sitemap.xml www/ && cp assets/vault-icon.svg www/assets/
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && find www/downloads -type f -name '*.apk' -delete && find android/app/src/main/assets/public/downloads -type f -name '*.apk' -delete 2>/dev/null || true; cap sync android
